s: October 29, 2024 - Senmut (ancient Egyptian: sn-mwt, "Mother's Brother") was a high official of the Eighteenth Dynasty during the New Kingdom. Senmut was of low commoner birth, born to Ramose and Hatnofret, literate commoners from Hermonthis (modern Armant). More information is known about Senmut than many other non-royal Egyptians because the joint tomb of his parents (the construction of which Senmut supervised himself) was discovered intact by the Metropolitan Museum in the mid-1930s and preserved.
